QuestInfo.name: Neinheart's Proposal
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has a proposal for you. No, it's not a marriage proposal.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart thinks you're ready to become an apprentice knight, instead of just being a trainee. Um, duh. You KNOW you're ready.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart thinks you're ready to become an apprentice knight, instead of just being a trainee. Um, duh. You KNOW you're ready.

0.0: Mihile, I have a proposal for you. Take up your father's mantle? Become the new Knight of Light.

yes.0: Good. It will be a tough path, but you will survive. You'll start as an apprentice knight and work your way up. There will be a Knighthood Examination to set you on your path. If you think you're ready, you can begin.

no.0: Pity, I thought you would have a little bit of courage in that thick skull.
